617:t_000:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「It's quite a sight. It's just what I'd expect from the elite troops guarding the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

617:t_000:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If it weren't for $$アウストラリス$$' orders, I'd have sortied with them, too.」

617:t_000:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It seems you've put it behind you.」

617:t_000:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「What are you talking about?」

617:t_000:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Haha, it really is embarrassing! Having someone overhear your confession of love!」

617:t_000:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Are you all right, though, $$尸空#pilot$$? About $$尸刻$$...」

617:t_000:7.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「To $$鬼宿$$, death is merely an outcome.」

617:t_000:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You two make me sick. You're acting like this is our last battle.」

617:t_000:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You do understand, don't you? We were promised eternity. Our battles will go on and on.」

617:t_000:12.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You don't have to tell me, $$バルビエル$$. ...But this will surely be our last battle on Earth.」

617:t_000:13.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Once we defeat $c, all that's left is cleaning up the small fry. We'll probably return to the galaxy.」

617:t_000:14.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「And we'll bring four new $$スフィア$$s as gifts.」

617:t_000:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Exactly. That's our duty as $$サイデリアル$$'s $$スフィア・リアクター$$s.」

617:t_000:16.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But we can't let our guard down. $c is completely different from when they came here before.」

617:t_000:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I know them better than you two do...」

617:t_000:18.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You share the same civilization of fire... You're fellow Earthlings...」

617:t_000:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Shut up, $$尸空#pilot$$. I am a chosen human, granted the name $$バルビエル$$.」

617:t_000:21.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Playtime's over. I want to kill them so badly I can hardly stand it...」

617:t_000:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$アウストラリス$$ gave me permission, too...! Even if it means letting the $$スフィア$$s escape, I will kill them!」

617:t_000:23.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If they don't listen to our offer, you can do that.」

617:t_001:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You $$リアクター|lc$$s! Are you just sitting back and watching?!」

617:t_001:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「So $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ isn't here either.」

617:t_001:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Acting all high and mighty! Like you're such big shots!」

617:t_001:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Judging by the Empire's $$リアクター|lc$$s, $$アウストラリス$$ is indeed their leader, but there's no clear hierarchy among them.)

617:t_001:4.en:
$$シャア$$
(We should assume he has some intention behind staying off the front line.)

617:t_001:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Welcome to $$ラース・バビロン$$! Here's to the courage that brought you back while the memory of fleeing in defeat is still fresh!」

617:t_001:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's a cheap taunt. You're disgracing your title as Supreme Commander of the imperial military.」

617:t_001:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Ouch, that was harsh.」

617:t_001:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But with one colleague who curses every time he opens his mouth and another who barely speaks, I have to be the MC.」

617:t_001:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「We didn't come here to make small talk!」

617:t_001:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Don't get so worked up. My darling $$ダバラーン$$ was defeated, and inside, I'm absolutely seething.」

617:t_001:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I wish you'd appreciate that I'm holding it in to talk to you.」

617:t_001:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If you wish to talk, I'll hear you out.」

617:t_001:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But first, tell us why $$サイデリアル$$ has abhorred humanity's evolution and kept Earth under surveillance.」

617:t_001:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...I can't tell you that.」

617:t_001:15.en:
$$シモン$$
「So you have no intention of talking to us seriously!」

617:t_001:16.en:
$$桂$$
「We can call the negotiations a failure, right, $$ロジャー$$?」

617:t_001:18.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Wait a minute! You're getting ahead of yourselves...」

617:t_001:19.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I don't want to fight you, you know.」

617:t_001:21.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are you getting cold feet at this point?!」

617:t_001:22.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Hmm... That's not quite the right expression, but it's true I respect your strength.」

617:t_001:23.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So... why don't you join $$サイデリアル$$, along with this whole planet?」

617:t_001:25.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「As you know, $$サイデリアル$$ is a military alliance of humans from different star systems.」

617:t_001:26.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I was a drifter myself before I was invited to join.」

617:t_001:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're trying to win over all of us, not just our four $$リアクター|lc$$s?」

617:t_001:28.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You could make unit commander right away, and some of you could be division commanders... No, even generals, I think.」

617:t_001:29.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Then the people of this planet would be collaborators instead of pets, and they'd be guaranteed a decent position.」

617:t_001:30.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Does a decent position mean being granted freedom under your surveillance?」

617:t_001:31.en:
$$レド$$
「That's no way for humans to live.」

617:t_001:32.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And those with strong life force would be used as parts in your $$次元力$$ control systems...!」

617:t_001:33.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Even so, the vast majority could live peaceful lives.」

617:t_001:35.en:
$$シン$$
「We know the truth! We won't let you do whatever you like to this planet anymore!」

617:t_001:36.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The world under your control ends today!」

617:t_001:38.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It's no use, $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

617:t_001:39.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Even after learning of those above them, this planet's humans aren't afraid. Their fighting spirit burns hotter.」

617:t_001:40.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's reckless courage born of ignorance. Their stupidity knows no bounds.」

617:t_001:41.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「There's no need to show people like that any mercy...!」

617:t_001:42.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Shut up! I won't be called stupid by someone who comes to other people's planet and does whatever they want!」

617:t_001:43.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If you respect us... respect us Earthlings, then give us our planet back!」

617:t_001:44.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...There's no room for negotiation, then.」

617:t_001:45.en:
$$赤木$$
「How can you call something so one-sided a negotiation?!」

617:t_001:46.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「So this battle really can't be avoided...!」

617:t_001:48.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is our will! Prepare yourselves, $$新地球皇国$$!」

617:t_001:49.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...This will please $$アウストラリス$$.」

617:t_001:50.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「First, let's watch how they fight the elite troops guarding this imperial capital.」

617:t_001:51.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Don't underestimate us, you scorpion bastard! If you think we'll go down easily, you're dead wrong!」

617:t_001:52.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We're here carrying the feelings of people all over the world!」

617:t_001:53.en:
$$ノノ$$
「The feelings of Earth's people, who won't flinch even before a mighty enemy, are pushing $c forward right now!」

617:t_001:54.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「The feelings of Earth's people, who won't flinch even before a mighty enemy, are pushing $c forward right now!」
